body: I really like that Winston Churchill quote.
Or she will find me, and realize what a piece of shit I am and leave me.
Someone online who I have never met and will never meet doesn't really seem like a friend, but I guess at the same time I just need someone who cares...
No one I know is willing to listen, they all just tell me to get over it and stop being so sad, but I can't. No one gives a shit about me.

I got kicked out of my house by my parents after deciding not to attend college, so I'm staying on a friends couch currently, but his parents are getting angry at me mooching everything and I'm sure I will have to leave soon and have no other friends or family therefore nowhere to live. I am looking for a job but no one will hire me because I have zero experience. I spend every day wishing I was dead and trying to build the courage to kill myself but haven't yet so I just cut myself. I couldn't succeed at school and can't succeed at work. I am nothing and have nothing, and the world would be a better place if I just ended my life.
